source.snippet: I can't even use 1b tokens a month because I review everything LLMs write. I even used AI to code my own harness in C and my own VSCode-like IDE in C++ and I still used under 1b the months where it did most of the coding. Just wondering how/what these guys claiming to use a full Claude/Codex 20x subscription are burning it on. (4 points, 3 comments)

problem_statement: Developers using AI coding assistants lack visibility into where their token/API spend actually goes, making it hard to justify large subscription tiers or optimize usage patterns for cost vs. output quality.
target_segment: Freelance developers and small dev teams paying for Claude Pro, Copilot, or Codex subscriptions who want to optimize AI spend
notes: Buyer signal: people are paying $20-200/month for AI coding subscriptions and questioning ROI. An analytics layer showing token spend by task/repo/session could command $10-30/month from power users. Adjacent to existing opportunity space but this item highlights the solo-dev segment specifically.
